source: Prince William County Development Services ePortal (Tyler EnerGov), public permit search
note: Permit descriptions that state a data centre's floor area and/or electrical load in the applicant's own words. These are the only per-building statements of the GFA-to-MW relationship found anywhere in this project, and they bear directly on the 8,818 sqft/MW ICPRB constant, which is the largest remaining swing factor in the estimator (46%).

statements.quote: THE PROJECT IS A TWO-STORY DATA CENTER AND OFFICE BUILDING AT AN APPROXIMATE 339,744 SF GROSS AREA. CONSTRUCTION WILL INCLUDE CORE AND SHELL OF THE BUILDING; (2) DATA HALLS AT LEVEL 1 AND (2) DATA HALLS AT LEVEL 2 WITH SUPPORTING ELECTRICAL AND MECHANICAL ROOMS, EXTERIOR SERVICE YARD, AND ROOF EQUIPMENT PLATFORM TO SUPPORT THE 60 MW CRITICAL LOAD PLANNED
statements.why_it_matters: The only record in the corpus stating BOTH floor area and load for the same building. 'Critical load' is IT load, the same quantity ICPRB's Effective (IT) Power Demand denotes, so the two are directly comparable.

statements.quote: NEW STRUCTURE DATA CENTER PERMIT PATHWAY. THE PROJECT IS A NEW TWO-STORY 96 MW DATA CENTER BUILDING THAT CONSISTS OF 12 DATA SERVER VAULTS, OFFICE AND ASSOCIATED SITE AND UTILITY INFRASTRUCTURE.
statements.why_it_matters: Which of the four NTT buildings on this parcel the 96 MW refers to is not stated, so it cannot be assigned. For scale, the model's permit-derived figures are 74.7 MW (VA10) and 77.3 MW (VA11); a GFA-derived VA10 would be 63.6 MW. The permit-derived path is the closer of the two to a stated 96 MW.

statements.quote: 2-story, 270,000 SF Data Center Building consisting of a steel building structure with precast insulated concrete skin.

Approx. 26,000 SF Data Hall with associated Mechanical and Electrical Gallery spaces (additional 12,000 SF) built in the existing East Shell space of Level Two in the existing QTS MAN1-DC5 Data Center.
statements.why_it_matters: Gives the data-hall-to-support-space ratio directly: 26,000 SF of hall to 12,000 SF of mechanical and electrical gallery, so roughly 68% of the fitted-out area is white space.
